changes: Shared account synchronization no longer blocks the document centre or editor
Route-specific static scripts and styles preload during HTML parsing
Management loads form definitions only when opening submitted details

checks: Document centre and editor work while the shared-profile response is still pending
Late account data fills untouched fields; an edit made while loading is preserved and conflict resolution saves it
Opening the document centre and editing fields fetches no PDF or PDF engine
Reload restores the confirmed account values
Management overview defers form definitions and PDF downloads until they are needed
Login/signup: EN and AR, desktop/mobile, source logos and role labels, no PDF engine or PDF loaded
Logged-out document routes redirect to sign-in
Real form edits propagate separate Arabic/English names and joined city/district to account and other forms
Offline edits retry to account; intentional clear persists after reload
Multiple tabs, fresh browser and individual/company/account isolation
Company English sharing is bidirectional and separate from Arabic identity
One-click unsigned submission, lost-response retry, single immutable version and receipt reference
Signed replacement archives the earlier PDF and all captured answers; stale replacement is rejected
Consent PDF upload works without inventing structured answers or signature verification
Management receives current versions, exact answers and signature status; preview/PDF/ZIP work; review controls disabled and cross-account access blocked
All eight filled forms submitted: 556 field values matched management records, and downloaded PDFs matched byte for byte

limits: A consistent 20-second delay was not observed on this connection. A simulated 12-second shared-profile response reproduced the blocking wait in the old build.
Live timing varies by network and device; the slow-sync comparison used isolated local fixtures.
Authentication checks remain mandatory; private account data is never stored in public caches.
